name: Bantayan
description: A tall bamboo watchtower at the shore or river bank. Its lookouts (bantay) take turns watching for war boats: raiders landing within its sight are seen early, and the alarm is raised.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Costs and staffing are playtest guesses (npm run simulate)
